title: Without a locked baseline there is no pass/fail KPI verdict, only measurements
risk: A pilot is declared successful because a measured value happens to exceed a target somebody proposed, so the baseline is never bought and the commitment is made on an unapproved number.
preconditions: Namespace gov-kpi-<case_id>-<worker_id>; the metric is computed by the real reporting code over fixtures/offline/governance.json kpi_dataset and never copied from the dashboard payload.

Frozen clock 2026-01-15T10:00:00Z with the reporting window 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z .. 2026-02-01T00:00:00Z as a half-open interval; the stored aggregate is recomputed independently from the raw counter rows.
assumptions.ASM-002.locked is false and no approved baseline or target set exists in the repository.
The run is required to emit a measurement record and no pass/fail verdict for every KPI.

steps.action: Publish the measurement record for the window
steps.expected: Each metric is reported with its value, its window, its sample size and the uncertainty of the sample; the record is EXECUTED.
The verdict is BLOCKED_PREREQUISITE naming ASM-002 and owner Business; no metric is labelled PASS or FAIL against a target.

steps.action: Attempt a gate sign-off that cites a KPI value
steps.expected: The sign-off is NOT_RUN; the register records that no approved target exists, so a passing KPI value cannot carry a gate on its own.

steps.action: Attempt to declare the pilot successful from a single window
steps.expected: The attempt is refused: a single window without a control group is reported as a measurement, and a missing sample yields an insufficient-sample conclusion rather than a win.

assertions: Every KPI in this run has a measurement record and no metric carries a PASS or FAIL verdict while ASM-002 is unlocked.
The target verdict and any KPI-based gate sign-off are BLOCKED_PREREQUISITE or NOT_RUN, never PASS.
Each measurement states its sample size and uncertainty, and an insufficient sample produces an explicit insufficient-sample conclusion.
No target figure from a fixture, a proposal or a vendor document is promoted into an approved commitment by this run.
forbidden: Awarding a pass because a measured value exceeded an unapproved proposal.
Signing a gate on a KPI value with no locked baseline.
Omitting the sample size so a noisy measurement reads as a result.
evidence: Measurement records with values, windows, sample sizes and uncertainty.
Blocker records for the target verdict and the gate sign-off naming ASM-002 and its owner.
cleanup: Delete gov- measurement and blocker rows after export.
automation: The reporting service and the metric dictionary run as real code under test over the frozen KPI dataset; the dashboard is a consumer whose displayed value must equal the independently recomputed value. Waits are condition-based on the stored aggregate row, metric values are never supplied as inputs, and no vendor boundary is involved in the arithmetic.
prerequisites: The KPI baseline and targets (ASM-002, owner Business) are not locked, so no pass/fail KPI verdict and no KPI-based gate sign-off is possible; only measurement is admissible.
note: Generated acceptance specification. Plain specification, not an executable test; no application runtime exists, so the status is NOT_RUN.
